description: This file defines functions related to the initial state of game coins, including a function to create the starting state for players' coins with positions set to 'yard'. It exports the initialCoinsState function and references an external list of default players.

methods.name: initialCoinsState
methods.description: Creates the initial state of coins for a list of players, defaulting to a predefined set of players. Each player has four coins with position set to 'yard'.
